target.title: docs(autoreview): document oversized bundle recovery
target.body:
## Summary

- document merge-base-aware neutralization for repository-declared, non-authoritative, non-shipping machine noise only
- require exact or semantic verification in trusted CI or a credential-free sandbox, with no unreviewed delivery-head generator execution on the host
- keep lockfiles and independently semantic generated artifacts in review, using a compact semantic diff or dataset when raw output is too large
- treat oversized subtree passes as diagnostic and partial; the merge gate remains blocked until the actual delivery change is split or reduced into integrated, fully reviewed units

This is the deliberate simplicity correction after the two-cycle review pause. The secret scanner remains fail-closed; its current aggregation boundary has no trustworthy fixture identity, so no generic long-value exception was added.

## Validation

- `scripts/validate-skills`
- `skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --help`
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`
- only `skills/autoreview/SKILL.md` changed
- no test files changed
